definition: in a bad or clumsy way
description: A bright café with round paper lamps, big windows and a wooden counter. A young female barista in a black apron, laughing and waving one hand, pours milk from a steel jug but misses the cup, so the milk floods across the counter and runs down its front. A grey cat leaps off the wet counter in fright, and a young man in a brown apron leans over and wipes up the mess with a cloth. A customer in a lilac jumper watches in the foreground, and people sit and stand behind.

en.question: What is the man in brown doing?

de.answer: Er wischt die Theke mit einem Tuch ab.
de.question: Was macht der Mann in Braun?

es.answer: Está limpiando el mostrador con un trapo.

fr.answer: Il essuie le comptoir avec un chiffon.
